en.description:
Mini Racing is a racing game with a Japanese neon arcade style. Drive through city streets, change lanes, dodge traffic and roadwork barriers, and cross the finish line before time runs out!

Features

• Neon arcade visuals
Dark city streets, pixel cars and vivid neon colors create a retro arcade atmosphere.

• 30 racing challenges
Unlock levels as you go and face increasingly heavy traffic and obstacles that test your reflexes and control.

• Race at your fingertips and on your wrist
Play on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. Drag left or right to steer on iPhone and iPad. On Apple Watch, swipe the screen or turn the Digital Crown.

• Beat your personal best
The on-device leaderboard saves your top 10 completed race results, including score, level and date.

Choose a level, start your engine and head for the finish line!

Note: Level progress and leaderboard results are stored separately on each device. Global rankings and cross-device syncing are not currently available.
en.releaseNotes:
Redesigned the finish line with cool-white and dark-blue checkers and subtle cyan accents to better match the arcade racing style.
Improved finish line alignment on bends and narrowing sections, adapting its angle and width to the road.
Refined display proportions on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch for a clearer, more consistent look.
en.sellerName: Nanjing Ningyue Network Technology Company Limited
en.subtitle: Fast racing on your wrist

zh.trackName: 迷你赛车-手表竞速游戏
zh.description:
极速9527是一款日式霓虹街机风格的赛车游戏。驾驶赛车穿过城市道路，灵活变道，躲避车流与施工路障，在倒计时结束前冲过终点！

游戏特色

• 霓虹街机画风
深色街景、像素赛车与醒目的霓虹色彩，营造复古街机氛围。

• 30关竞速挑战
逐步解锁关卡，应对越来越密集的车流与障碍，挑战自己的反应和操控。

• 指尖与腕上驾驶
支持 iPhone、iPad 和 Apple Watch。手机和平板左右拖动转向，手表支持滑动屏幕或旋转数码表冠操控。

• 挑战个人纪录
本机排行榜保存已结束比赛的前10名成绩，记录分数、关卡与日期。
选择关卡，开始赛车，向终点出发！

说明：关卡进度和排行榜成绩分别保存在各自设备上，当前不提供全球排名或跨设备同步。
zh.releaseNotes:
焕新终点线设计，采用冷白与深蓝小方格，搭配细青色边线，与街机赛道风格更加统一。
优化终点线在弯道和变窄路段的显示，随道路方向调整角度与宽度。
改善 iPhone、iPad 和 Apple Watch 上的显示比例，让终点标线更清晰、协调

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
New in this version:
• Added iPad support with a responsive layout.
• Added new obstacles and emergency vehicles with matching sounds.
• Added military-green fuel cans and a final-10-second countdown warning.
• Improved Apple Watch navigation and full-screen gameplay.

• Extended bend transitions to six times their previous length for a smoother driving experience.
• Added trapezoid-shaped road transitions from Level 2, narrowing from three lanes to two and widening back to three.
• Improved vehicle merging, braking and yielding, with obstacle placement adapted to the available lanes.

Redesigned the finish line with cool-white and dark-blue checkers and subtle cyan accents to better match the arcade racing style.
Improved finish line alignment on bends and narrowing sections, adapting its angle and width to the road.
Refined display proportions on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch for a clearer, more consistent look.
